stemMd: Let P be true and Q false. Which expression is true?
explanationMd: Negating Q gives true, so P and not Q combines two true statements. Each competing expression contains a false component that makes it false under the stated truth values.

distractorRationale.d: The conjunction fails because Q is false.
distractorRationale.a: A true antecedent with false consequent makes this false.
